status: selected scalar equations implemented; full phase API not ported

translations.behavior: Immutable state transformation; pressure changes while density and molar volume remain fixed.

translations.python: StoichiometricSubstance enthalpy, entropy, Gibbs, internal energy, and cp/cv
StoichiometricSubstance activities, concentrations, and partial molar properties

behavioral_choices_and_limits: A single Species and a positive density or molar volume are required; no YAML/model construction is provided.
States are immutable; with_pressure is the documented pure-Python analogue of the source mutable setPressure method.
Runtime imports only Python standard-library math and existing pure-Python port modules.
excluded_methods_and_features: ThermoPhase inheritance, mutable state, species management, units, YAML parsing, serialization, and factory registration
Equilibrium, kinetics, transport, derivatives, electrochemistry, reactors, and numerical solvers
